name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code — parallel AI coding with Git worktrees and native cmux.app. A King (👑 Opus) coordinates generic workers (👷), co-workers (🧑‍💼), and watchmen (🕵️) — each in its own cmux.app workspace with role-coloured sidebar badges and native notifications. Three-tier hierarchy: Workspace per master, Tab for visible sub-agent spawns (default — auto-close on sentinel), Split for predefined dual-view (watchman). King reads ALL context at session start (workspace + project CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, personal notes) before watchman state; uses watchman outputs at every decision point; auto-fires the pre-commit gate on every un-gated sentinel (no idle on completed work). Workers are interchangeable capacity; King assigns task scope per-dispatch. Domain-agnostic: code, research, finance, science, manuscripts. Bootstrap with /kingdom:init; spawn lanes with /kingdom:start; audit gaps with /kingdom:update; gracefully close with /kingdom:exit. Per-task multi-layer task files + 4/5-step closer artifact pipeline make the work auditable. Won't touch your project files, develop/main branches, shell config, or git config.
